When searching for vector database performance benchmarks, generic queries like 'vector database comparison' returned SEO content. Adding 'benchmark github site:github.com' to queries produced substantially higher-quality primary source results including actual benchmark repositories.

**Suggested rule**: For comparative topics on developer tools, add `site:github.com` variant queries to the initial query plan to surface primary benchmark data.
